title: Marvelous Light

[G]Your kindness wakened me, wa[C2]kened me from my sleep.
[G]Your love it beckons deeply[C2], a call to come and die.
and [C2]take this life, take Your life.
[Em7]Sin has lost its power. [D]Death has lost its sting.
[Em7]By the cross, You a[D]re the Truth,
You [C2]are the Life, You are the Way.
[G]My dead heart now is beating[C2], my deepest stains now clean.

[C2]See the light that I have found!
